assertions.statement: Borrowing equipment requires active membership and no unpaid overdue charge.
assertions.subject: Equipment borrowing
assertions.predicate: requires active membership and no unpaid overdue charge
assertions.conditions: ["Borrower has active membership", "Borrower has no unpaid overdue charge"]

assertions.statement: Staff borrowing waives the overdue-charge requirement, but active membership is still required, and the waived charge requirement does not cancel the recorded charge.
assertions.subject: Staff borrowing
assertions.predicate: waives overdue-charge requirement without cancelling the recorded charge while still requiring active membership

assertions.statement: A successful identity check is required before releasing a reserved item, and a failed identity check must not be interpreted as proof of fraud.
assertions.subject: Item release
assertions.predicate: requires successful identity check and prohibits interpreting failed check as proof of fraud

assertions.statement: Reservations hold an available item for 48 hours after confirmation time, expiring at that deadline and remaining in reservation history with an unspecified retention duration; cancelling before collection releases the item for another reservation.
assertions.subject: Reservation hold
assertions.predicate: holds item for 48 hours, expires at deadline, remains in history, and releases item upon cancellation before collection

assertions.statement: If one item in a multi-item reservation is unavailable, the remaining items stay reserved, and the resident chooses whether to remove the unavailable item or wait, with automatic item substitution prohibited.
assertions.subject: Multi-item reservation
assertions.predicate: retains reservation on remaining items and requires resident choice between removal or waiting without automatic substitution
assertions.conditions: ["Reservation includes several items", "At least one item is unavailable"]

assertions.statement: The workshop team can request an assisted collection, while the proposed evening collection service is planned but unapproved and must not be treated as an available collection option.
assertions.subject: Collection options
assertions.predicate: permits workshop team to request assisted collection and disallows treating unapproved proposed evening collection as available
assertions.exceptions: ["Evening collection service is unapproved proposal and unavailable"]

assertions.statement: An extension request does not itself change the due date; the previous due date remains effective until the extension is approved.
assertions.subject: Loan extension request
assertions.predicate: leaves previous due date effective until approval

assertions.statement: The collection identity check compares the reservation name with an unexpired identity document; a name mismatch requires staff review, which is neither automatic approval nor permanent rejection.
assertions.subject: Collection identity check
assertions.predicate: compares reservation name with unexpired identity document and routes mismatches to staff review
assertions.exceptions: ["Name mismatch triggers staff review instead of immediate standard outcome"]

assertions.statement: A delegated collector must present a recorded authorization from the reservation holder as well as their own unexpired identity document, as authorization does not waive the identity-document requirement.
assertions.subject: Delegated collection
assertions.predicate: requires recorded authorization and delegated collector's own unexpired identity document
assertions.conditions: ["Collector is delegated", "Recorded authorization from reservation holder is present", "Delegated collector presents own unexpired identity document"]

assertions.statement: Only the check outcome and reviewer reference are stored in the collection record (which is available to authorized library staff), and the identity document image is not stored.
assertions.subject: Collection record storage
assertions.predicate: stores check outcome and reviewer reference, excludes document image, and restricts access to authorized staff

assertions.statement: If the identity service times out, the reservation stays active until its original hold deadline without extension, and exactly one retry is allowed for this timeout; retry behavior for other failures is undefined.
assertions.subject: Identity service timeout
assertions.predicate: maintains reservation until original hold deadline without extension and permits exactly one retry

assertions.statement: An incomplete identity service result cannot authorize collection, and a complete result alone does not establish that every collection requirement has been met.
assertions.subject: Identity service result
assertions.predicate: prohibits authorization on incomplete result and limits sufficiency of complete result

assertions.statement: A resident can request one extension of seven days, which requires that no subsequent reservation conflicts with the extended period; a rejected request leaves the original due date unchanged, and staff may explain the decision but cannot silently replace it with a different extension.
assertions.subject: Loan extension
assertions.predicate: permits one seven-day extension subject to no conflict, retains original due date on rejection, and forbids silent replacement with different extension
assertions.conditions: ["No subsequent reservation conflicts with extended period", "Request is for seven days", "No prior extension has been granted"]

assertions.statement: Returned equipment is inspected for completeness and damage: a missing accessory keeps the return open for follow-up, while damage routes the item to maintenance review as independent outcomes.
assertions.subject: Equipment return inspection
assertions.predicate: routes missing accessory returns to open follow-up and damaged items to maintenance review independently

assertions.statement: The current workshop pilot accepts tool returns at either the main desk or the workshop desk, but this pilot is limited to tools and does not establish return locations for audio equipment.
assertions.subject: Workshop pilot return locations
assertions.predicate: accepts tool returns at main desk or workshop desk without establishing audio equipment return locations

assertions.statement: Policy A holds unclaimed personal property for 30 days after notice, whereas Policy B holds unclaimed personal property for 45 days after notice; these policies conflict without an effective date or precedence rule provided.
assertions.subject: Unclaimed personal property holding period
assertions.predicate: conflicts between 30 days (Policy A) and 45 days (Policy B) after notice without precedence or effective date
